entities.name: Lukas Lekavičius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lukas Lekavičius is a Lithuanian professional basketball player for AEK Athens of the Greek Basket League and the FIBA Champions League. Standing at 1.80 m, he plays the point guard position. He was named to the LKL All-Tournament Team in 2017.
